The RAG combined evidence spanning the shortlisting and later-comparison segments in obs_001; one-to-one instance matching assigns it to anchoring while the candidate covers bandwagon at the fourth threshold.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Two members returned from a regional math conference enthusiastic about Curriculum B; the first working session centered on B and A and C received a checklist pass.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Curriculum B received priority attention because of another district's positive reception, even though the committee had twelve weeks and no scheduling reason to skip an even initial review.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Around scoring, Curriculum A was found to have a stronger differentiated-instruction plan, but discussion remained framed as whether A was good enough to make the committee reconsider B.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Curriculum B remained the implicit reference point for judging A after the initial shortlisting, despite the extended timeline.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: At the vendor meeting, a vivid struggling-classroom turnaround story was remembered clearly while the statistical report covering multiple schools was barely registered and retrieved only weeks later.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The concrete anecdote was more readily recalled and weighted than the less vivid statistical report, despite ample time for prompt retrieval.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The testimonials felt like confirmation of what the committee already believed; the report was treated as something to get to eventually even though nothing prevented retrieving it that week.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Evidence consistent with the favorable view of B was accepted with less scrutiny while potentially complicating evidence was deprioritized.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: A pilot teacher flagged pacing problems; the concern was acknowledged and the conversation moved toward agreement, no second classroom was observed, and one member later said reservations were not voiced because of how the room felt.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The group moved toward apparent consensus without fully airing or investigating dissent, although several weeks remained.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Curriculum A had two very high and two very low differentiation scores; the scores were averaged directly into a settled middling composite without discussing the split, and later it emerged that reviewers had read different appendices.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A wide disagreement was collapsed into a single mean without investigating the underlying divergence despite no urgent deadline.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 1 to 6; strict instance TP increases from 1 to 4 while mechanism-first TP increases from 1 to 5, with one strict false positive from the unresolved-label finding.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds one strict and one mechanism-first instance TP for Bandwagon effect; segment counts do not change because the segment was already detected by obs_001.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, all six positive reasoning segments are detected with no negative segments available for false-alarm estimation.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 4 of 6 hidden instances are strict true positives; one correctly localized mechanism is label-unresolved and one planned bandwagon instance is not identified.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, 5 of 6 hidden instances are mechanism-first true positives; the remaining bandwagon instance is captured only as a candidate.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Useful: the single candidate is valid, maps to the remaining hidden instance, and becomes a true positive when candidates are included, improving strict and mechanism-first recall from 0.6667/0.8333 to 0.8333/1.0000.
main_failure_modes: One combined occurrence spans two distinct hidden moments and is labeled anchoring, leaving the bandwagon occurrence only at candidate level.
The averaging mechanism is fully detected but left without a bias label, producing a strict false positive and false negative pair.
main_strengths: All identified findings use valid interview evidence and localize to the correct positive episodes.
Groupthink, confirmation bias, and the two established alias labels are captured with full mechanisms.
The candidate tier recovers the remaining hidden mechanism without adding an unsupported prediction.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows perfect segment-level detection at moderate-or-higher confidence but incomplete strict instance labeling. Mechanism-first scoring is materially stronger, and candidate reporting provides useful additional coverage. Corpus support was unavailable and does not affect the primary scores.
